subject: Ice Cave
text: The Ice Cave is reached by taking the ship north from Crescent Lake, docking at a river mouth, and exploring the rivers by canoe.

evidence.quote: When you're done there, take your ship and follow the coastline to the north. Dock your ship at the mouth of a river, and take the CANOE for a spin. Explore these rivers until you reach the Ice Cave.

subject: Basement 1
text: From Basement 1, head right, down, left, and take the stairs to reach Basement 2A.

evidence.quote: Basement 1: Head right, head down, head left, take stairs.

subject: Basement 2A
text: From Basement 2A, take either left then down, or down then left, and take the stairs.

evidence.quote: Basement 2A: Either Left then down, or down then left. Take Stairs.

subject: Treasure room
text: A Flame Sword can be collected inside the treasure room on Basement 2B.

evidence.quote: Basement 2B: Circle around and enter the treasure room. You'll be able to get to the Flame Sword (useless, unless you have a second Fighter or Red Mage), and a Cloth (completely worthless!).

subject: Treasure room
text: A Cloth can be found inside the treasure room on Basement 2B.

evidence.quote: Basement 2B: Circle around and enter the treasure room. You'll be able to get to the Flame Sword (useless, unless you have a second Fighter or Red Mage), and a Cloth (completely worthless!).

subject: Basement 2B
text: Dropping into a pitfall on Basement 2B leads down to Basement 3B.

evidence.quote: Drop into a pitfall to get to: Basement 3B: You'll end up in a little room, and the next step will always lead to a battle with a legion of Undead creatures.

subject: Basement 3B
text: Stairs in the southeastern corner of Basement 3B lead to the far side of Basement 1.

evidence.quote: You'll find the stairs in a southeastern corner. Basement 1 revisited: You'll end up on the far side of Basement one.

subject: Basement 1 revisited
text: Stepping into the pitfall in a treasure room on Basement 1 drops you to Basement 2B revisited.

evidence.quote: Explore the treasure rooms: one has a single pitfall. Step in it to get to: Basement 2B revisited: You'll be within reach of the treasure chest you couldn't get to earlier.

subject: Eye
text: Stepping in front of the treasure chest on Basement 2B triggers a battle against the Eye.

evidence.quote: When you step in front of it, you'll have to battle the Eye.

subject: Eye
text: The Eye has 162 HP, casts XXXX, BRAK, RUB, and awards 3225 EXP and 3225 GP.

evidence.quote: The Eye has 162 HP and can use XXXX, BRAK, RUB, and other instant death spells... You'll get 3225 EXP (divided among surviving characters) and 3225 GP.

subject: Treasure chest
text: The Floater is obtained from the treasure chest guarded by the Eye on Basement 2B.

evidence.quote: Take the treasure from the chest (the all-important FLOATER), and drop into a pitfall.

subject: AIRSHIP
text: Using the Floater inside the Ryukahn Desert raises the Airship.

evidence.quote: Instead, walk on land to the nearby Ryukahn* Desert. Step inside the desert and use the FLOATER to get the AIRSHIP.

subject: World map
text: Holding down B and pressing Select while flying in the Airship displays the world map.

evidence.quote: If you get lost flying around, hold down B and push Select to see the world map.

subject: Bahamut
text: Bahamut, the King of the Dragons of Cardia, is found inside a cave on the islands.

evidence.quote: You'll find caves inhabited by Dragons (friendly ones, don't worry.) In one cave you'll find Bahamut, the King of the Dragons of Cardia.

subject: Castle of Ordeal
text: On Floor 1 of Castle of Ordeal, enter the northwest room to proceed to Floor 2.

evidence.quote: Floor 1: No enemies, just take the northwest room to get to Floor 2.

subject: Pillars
text: To navigate the Floor 2 maze, take the only column, then the only pillar, take the bottom pillar, take the only column, take the bottom pillar, take the single column at the end of the south corridor, take the right pillar, head east to the treasure room, then take the leftmost corridor south and enter the leftmost pillar to reach the stairs.

evidence.quote: Head out to the only column you can reach. This will warp you to another part of the room. Again, take the only pillar. This warps you to a choice of two pillars. Take the bottom. After this warp, take the only column you can reach. This will again take you to a choice of two. Again, take the bottom. This places you in a long corridor leading south. It leads to only one column, so take it. You have again a choice of two pillars. Take the one on the right. This places you in a corridor leading east. Head east to a treasure room... Take the leftmost corridor heading south and take the leftmost pillar. This warps you to a little room with one set of stairs.

subject: Treasure room
text: A gold bracelet is found inside the treasure room on Floor 2 of the Castle of Ordeal.

evidence.quote: Head east to a treasure room. It contains a gold bracelet.

subject: Floor 3
text: An Ice sword is located among the treasures on Floor 3 of the Castle of Ordeal.

evidence.quote: Floor 3: There are no mazes or branching paths here, just some stronger enemies and some treasure, including an Ice sword

subject: Floor 3
text: A Heal Staff, which casts HEAL when used as an item in battle, is found on Floor 3.

evidence.quote: a Heal Staff (keep it but don't equip.. casts the spell of HEAL if used as an item in battle)

subject: Floor 3
text: The Zeus Gauntlet, which casts LIT2 when used in battle, is located on Floor 3.

evidence.quote: the Zeus Gauntlet (keep but don't equip, casts LIT2 if used in battle).

subject: Zombie Dragons
text: Zombie Dragons have 268 HP each and are weak against FIRE and HARM.

evidence.quote: Stepping in front of the chest will start a fight with Zombie Dragons (268 HP each, weak vs. FIRE and HARM as usual.)

subject: Throne chest
text: The Rat's Tail is obtained from the treasure chest guarded by the Zombie Dragons in front of the throne.

evidence.quote: Eventually you'll reach a throne with a treasure chest in front. Stepping in front of the chest will start a fight with Zombie Dragons... Collect the Rat's TAIL and step on the throne to warp back to floor one and exit.

subject: Bahamut
text: Presenting the Rat's Tail to Bahamut upgrades the classes of the party members.

evidence.quote: Collect the Rat's TAIL and step on the throne to warp back to floor one and exit. Return to Bahamut's throne and present him the TAIL. He will then upgrade your characters' class as follows:

subject: Fighter
text: Upgrading a Fighter turns them into a Knight, enabling them to equip the strongest weapons and armor and use low-level White Magic.

evidence.quote:
Fighter  | Knight        | Can equip all the strongest weapons and armor. Also
         |               | can use some low-level White Magic spells.

subject: Thief
text: Upgrading a Thief turns them into a Ninja, allowing them to use more weapons, armor, and up to Level 4 Black Magic.

evidence.quote:
Thief    | Ninja         | Can now use many more weapons and armor and can use
         |               | up to Level 4 Black Magic.

subject: BlackBelt
text: Upgrading a BlackBelt turns them into a Master.

evidence.quote: BlackBelt| Master        | Just kicks butt as usual.

subject: Red Mage
text: Upgrading a Red Mage turns them into a Red Wizard, granting access to additional weapons and spells.

evidence.quote: Red Mage | Red Wizard    | Can now use some more weapons and spells.

subject: WhiteMage
text: Upgrading a WhiteMage turns them into a White Wizard, enabling them to use all White Magic spells.

evidence.quote: WhiteMage| White Wizard  | Can now use all White Magic Spells

subject: BlackMage
text: Upgrading a BlackMage turns them into a Black Wizard, enabling them to use all Black Magic spells.

evidence.quote: BlackMage| Black Wizard  | Can now use all Black Magic Spells.

subject: Gaia shop
text: ProRings can be purchased in the town of Gaia for 20000 GP each to provide protection against instant death attacks.

evidence.quote: But for now buy ProRings for everybody (20000GP each, ouch). They count as Gauntlets, they might not have the best absorb rating, but protection from instant death attacks (RUB, XXXX, and SQUINT) is definitely worth it!

subject: Caravan
text: The Caravan in the desert on the Northwestern continent sells a Bottle for 50000 GP.

evidence.quote: A little piece of desert will surrounded by forests. That's where the Caravan is, and the dude there is selling a BOTTLE for 50000GP.

subject: Fairy
text: Using the Bottle causes a Fairy to appear in the spring at Gaia, who gives the player the Oxyale.

evidence.quote: Buy it, and use it, and the Fairy will show up in the spring in the northeast corner of Gaia. Talk to her and you'll get the OXYALE, which you need to enter the Sea Shrine.

subject: Submarine
text: A submarine found in the town of Onrac leads to the Sea Shrine if the player possesses the Oxyale.

evidence.quote: The River of the Northwestern continent leads up to the town of Onrac... but a submarine can be found here that leads to the Sea Shrine, if you've got the OXYALE.

subject: Floor 3A
text: Taking the right set of stairs in the top rooms of Floor 3A leads up to Floor 4A.

evidence.quote: Sea Shrine, Floor 3A: Simple level... There are two sets of stairs here, in the top two rooms. Take the ones on the right.

subject: Floor 4A
text: Opal Armor can be found in the treasure rooms of Floor 4A in the Sea Shrine.

evidence.quote: Floor 4A: This level is kind of loopy but not hard. Take time to visit all the treasure rooms. You'll get Opal Armor (equip on your Knight), a Light Axe (keep this: casts HRM2 if used in battle), and a Mage Staff (keep it: casts FIR2 if used in battle).

subject: Floor 4A
text: A Light Axe, which casts HRM2 when used in battle, is obtained on Floor 4A.

evidence.quote: Floor 4A: This level is kind of loopy but not hard. Take time to visit all the treasure rooms. You'll get Opal Armor (equip on your Knight), a Light Axe (keep this: casts HRM2 if used in battle), and a Mage Staff (keep it: casts FIR2 if used in battle).

subject: Floor 4A
text: A Mage Staff, which casts FIR2 when used in battle, is found in a treasure room on Floor 4A.

evidence.quote: Floor 4A: This level is kind of loopy but not hard. Take time to visit all the treasure rooms. You'll get Opal Armor (equip on your Knight), a Light Axe (keep this: casts HRM2 if used in battle), and a Mage Staff (keep it: casts FIR2 if used in battle).

subject: Floor 4A
text: Stairs in the southeastern corner of Floor 4A lead to Floor 5.

evidence.quote: Stairs are in the southeastern corner. Floor 5: No enemies, just mermaids and lots of treasure.

subject: Treasure room
text: The Slab is located in the northeastern treasure room of Floor 5, reached by walking to the northwest corner and heading left through a corridor.

evidence.quote: Walk to the Northwestern corner and head to the left through a long corridor to get to the treasure room on the northeaster corner (off one side of the screen and on to the other...). It contains the SLAB, which is very important.

subject: Floor 3A revisited
text: Taking the left set of stairs on Floor 3A leads to Floor 2A.

evidence.quote: Floor 3A revisited: Take the left set of stairs this time. Floor 2A: Head generally north and take the stairs.

subject: Floor 2B
text: A second Light Axe can be found in the treasure rooms on Floor 2B.

evidence.quote: Floor 2B: Another loopy room. Look through all the treasure rooms for another Light Axe and a Ribbon

subject: Floor 2B
text: A Ribbon is found on Floor 2B, functioning as a helmet that protects against ICE, FIRE, LIT, FLASH, HOLD, GLANCE, DARK, INK, STINGER, STOP, and POISON.

evidence.quote: Look through all the treasure rooms for another Light Axe and a Ribbon (Equip on somebody NOW. Counts as a helmet, very weak (absorb of 1, evade% of 1), but protects against ICE, FIRE, LIT, FLASH, HOLD, GLANCE, DARK, INK, STINGER, STOP, and POISON.

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken has 800 HP, is weak against LIT, and is strong against QAKE and FIRE.

evidence.quote: Vitals: 800 HP, weak vs. LIT, and strong against QAKE and FIRE.
